title: Annual Alumni Mixer & Panel
description:
The Biostatistics Student Association is proud to host our 2026 Alumni Mixer Panel.

This panel provides an opportunity for students to learn about alumni career journeys, gain insights into their professional experience, and hear about the resources at UCLA that supported their path.

Event Details:
Friday, May 1, 2026
5:30 to 8:30pm PDT
Location: UCLA (in-person)

Dinner will be provided for all in-person attendees, and parking on campus will be covered.

Schedule:
  • Alumni Panel (5:30 to 7:00pm): A moderated discussion where alumni share their career journeys, professional experiences, and reflections on their time at UCLA. Alumni joining from out of state are welcome to participate via Zoom.
  • Mixer (7:00 to 8:30pm): An informal in-person gathering where students, faculty, and alumni can mingle over dinner.

Whether you're joining us on campus or over Zoom for the panel, we'd love to have you!
